The best choice for impact tensile tests and impact bending tests on metals to ISO 148 
• - With the HIT450P pendulum impact tester (450 joules), Charpy, Izod, Brugger, impact tensile and wedge impact tests can be performed to all established standards including DIN 50115 and DIN 51233, or ISO 148, ISO 14556 and ISO 8256. In addition, all international standards such as EN, ASTM and BS can be tested. 
• - For simple metals applications, ZwickRoell offers the new HIT300P pendulum impact tester, exclusively as part of a promotional package. The complete solution is ideal for standard-compliant tests up to 300 joules. 
• - The PSW 750 (750 joules) pendulum impact tester can be used for Charpy and impact tensile tests to all established DIN, EN, ASTM, ISO and BS standards.
